Day 1. Packed the bag and left the village at dawn.
The road to the forest was muddy.
Heard a wolf howling far away.
Made a fire and ate bread.
Day 2. Found a strange map in an old tree.
The map shows a cave north of the river.
Crossed the river on a fallen log.
A Wolf watched me from the hill.
I kept walking and did not look back.
Day 3. Rain all morning.
Dried my socks by the fire.
Counted my supplies: 4 apples, 2 bread, 1 rope.
Day 4. Reached the edge of the forest.
Owls everywhere. One seemed to talk.
The map says the treasure is deeper than it looks.
Found the cave entrance behind a waterfall.
Day 5. Went into the cave with a torch.
Bats! Hundreds of them.
Heard the WOLF again, closer this time.
Blocked the entrance with rocks.
Day 6. Followed a tunnel downward.
Marked the path on the map so I can find my way back.
The tunnel split in two. Chose the left.
Found a heavy chest.
Day 7. The chest is locked.
Tried every key on my ring. None fit.
Left a note for the next explorer.
Walked back to the village to rest.
The wolf followed me to the gate, then turned away.
Next time I will bring better tools. Maybe a terminal.
